### A Reflection of Christ - Today's Insight - June 4-5, 2016
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-june-4-5-2016.html
Passage: Isaiah 30:18
Points:
- People often approach God fearing rejection or condemnation because of their past guilt.
- In Christ, God answers human fear with unexpected generosity, mercy, and complete forgiveness.
- Human efforts to bargain or earn pardon can never settle the debt of sin.
- God actively waits to pour out grace and invites believers to feast at His table.

### A Prayer Because the Silence Is the Hardest Part - Your Daily Prayer - September 12
Author: Rachel Wojo
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-because-the-silence-is-the-hardest-part.html
Passage: Isaiah 30:18
Points:
- We often seek self-reliant, visible solutions instead of choosing quiet trust and rest in God.
- Silence from heaven does not mean the Lord is distant or withholding His mercy.
- God waits with eager expectation to show compassion to His people.
- Believers must stop trying to earn God's favor and instead surrender to His waiting presence.

### Missed Exits: Turning Up the Voice of God - Encouragement for Today - July 18, 2022
Author: Shala W. Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-18-2022.html
Passage: Isaiah 30:21
Points:
- Life detours occur when we allow distractions to drown out God's directions.
- The Lord promises to instruct and guide His people back when they cry out to Him.
- The Holy Spirit serves as an internal guide telling us the way to walk.
- Engaging in worship and Scripture softens worldly noise and clarifies God's voice in our hearts.
- When we stray from God's path, His grace is always available to redirect us.

### Following God as Our Guide - iBelieve Truth - November 15, 2023
Author: Alexis A. Goring
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/following-god-as-our-guide.html
Passage: Isaiah 30:21
Points:
- People readily trust digital navigation without hesitation, yet frequently second-guess God's guidance.
- Leaning on personal wisdom instead of God's leading leads to frustration and spiritual missteps.
- God is an all-knowing Master Teacher who faithfully redirects believers when they veer off course.
- Following Christ through life's highs and lows safely leads us to our eternal home.
